name: Lion Will

abilities.name: Pride's Poise
abilities.effect: A lion's poise: a short burst of steadiness and bonus bite while it lasts.

abilities.name: Cub's Roar
abilities.effect: A short startling roar: up to three foes within 6 blocks are nudged back and flinch (SNIPPET: the World Howl is present from phase 1, here only a cub's utility version).

acquire.equipPiece: One gold mane collar at the nape (the only equipped piece); warm gold impact lines on strikes.

abilities.name: Sovereign's Full Howl
abilities.effect: The full World Howl: a roar that hits up to eight foes in a cone, knocking them back and cracking the ground (bosses resist).

abilities.name: Royal Paw
abilities.effect: A gold-clawed paw swipe that sends a short shockwave through up to four foes.

integrate.transformation: Whole body becomes a lion beastman in gold pelt plate: full flowing mane, round ears and heavy brow, blunt-fanged muzzle, fur-ruffed chest, heavy clawed paws with a talon gauntlet, digitigrade legs and a tufted tail.

equip.weapon: A royal claw-gauntlet: gold talon blades on the right fist.
equip.armor: Gold-plated lion-pelt cuirass with a mane-ruff gorget and heavy paw greaves.
equip.hair_eyes: Deep-red mane to the shoulders; gold eyes.
equip.aura: A gold corona with earth-brown dust at the feet.

lore: A pride-king lion's will: the first stage lends a lion's poise and a cub's roar, the second makes a lion king whose howl shakes the ground.
pitch: The World Lion is a pride-king lion whose howl shakes the world; this is our own lion will, since Curtis only has a bond with a lion cub. Acquire keeps you human with one gold mane collar, lending a lion's poise and a small cub's roar that nudges foes back. Integrate makes you an upright lion beastman in gold pelt plate with a flowing red mane, clawed paws and a tufted tail, a bruiser whose full World Howl and royal paw are paid for with a strain that climbs on every roar.
untrained: An untrained holder cannot hold the pride's pride: the mane-heat burns the neck and shoulders, the howl cracks the holder's own throat and strain spikes if the Full Howl is spammed. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

spirit.echo: An upright lion beastman: heavy deep-red mane to the shoulders, round ears, golden eyes, blunt fangs, broad fur-ruffed chest, digitigrade legs, tufted tail, heavy clawed paws.
spirit.look: A golden orb ringed by a thick mane of dark-red fur strands with two small canine-white points, pulsing slowly like a heartbeat.
